name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight grounded and even, shoulders squared to the camera, chin level, a focused and steady gaze — a disciplined, battle-ready stance, his expression cold and unreadable, shadow pooling faintly at his feet.
effects: Even, natural torchlight; no additional magical effects.

components.wearing: heavy Obsidian Black-toned plate armor over the chest and shoulders, Tarnished Silver trim and rivets, thick pauldrons, a reinforced waist-guard; forearms and shins in matching plated vambraces and greaves; a cracked skull sigil emblazoned over the chest plate, etched with faint shadow-runes
components.companion: his bonded Reaper, a towering spectral reaper cloaked in tattered black robes, scythe in hand, looming silently in the shadows behind him

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the tank-group default wardrobe set + the existing ossuary background (fits Darkness thematically). Uses the new scene-combat-human.txt template (no casting-eyes-glow line, correct for a non-caster martial hero).
